reason: A configuration-driven lifecycle hook plugin that automates shell commands around model tool calls, with pre-tool failures able to block execution.

summaries.zh: 通过配置在模型工具调用前后自动运行 Shell 命令，并支持在前置命令失败时阻止工具执行。
summaries.en: Configures shell commands to run before and after model tool calls, with failed pre-tool commands able to block execution.

capabilities: Executes configured shell commands before and after model tool calls
Reads JSON tool-event payloads from standard input
Can block matching tool calls when pre-tool commands fail
Records hook execution results and supports configuration hot reload
